hook: 3 biases that quietly run your decisions.
facts: Number one: the *default effect*. Austria's organ donor rate: *99.98%*. Germany's: *12%*.
The only difference? Opt out versus *opt in*.
Number two: the *planning fallacy*. Students guessed *34* days for a thesis. It took *56*.
Number three: *loss aversion*. Losing hurts about *twice* as much as winning feels good.
title: Psychology Facts
